scope: Exactly the assigned 30 IDs, individually reviewed against bound predicates/reachable helpers/native collectors/current official API contracts.

validation.network_guard: Autouse fixture forbids socket.create_connection, socket.socket.connect, socket.getaddrinfo and GCP Credentials. Every fake request asserts GET plus exact URL or its equivalent scheme/host/path allowlist.
validation.mutation_guard: Each evaluation deep-compares its input snapshot before/after.
validation.partial_inventory_contract: Returned resources retain their local verdict and an additional UNKNOWN finding accounts for uncollected remainder. Dependency incompleteness prevents absence-based PASS.
validation.test_harness_corrections: Initial runs corrected an incorrect single-finding assumption for partial inventory, fault injection into unused route objects, and harmless identical identity deduplication. The final preserved failures use valid native response witnesses.

parity.semantic_scope: Current upstream lineage and verified cached evaluator content are individually linked; mappings do not establish semantic equivalence and intentional applicability/MANUAL differences are explicit.

constraints.owner_policy_exclusions: All assigned IDs are active; no deliberate archived owner-policy exclusion is relabeled as missing automation.

checks.title: App Engine serving versions enforce HTTPS

official_api_contracts.assessment: Handler securityLevel is native HTTPS configuration; SECURE_ALWAYS redirects HTTP to HTTPS. A security-level-only field mask omits handler routing.

checks.evaluator_assessment: The currently bound batch_remaining_gcp predicate requires complete version inventory, in-project name, SERVING status, and unmasked full handler representation. STOPPED skips; partial masked SERVING responses remain UNKNOWN even when every selected level is SECURE_ALWAYS.
checks.producer_assessment: gcp_appengine_versions.list_versions sends view=FULL plus versions(id,name,servingStatus,env,handlers(securityLevel)),nextPageToken, explicitly marks representation partial, and omits handler URL/routing fields. Current production can never supply this predicate a full SERVING handler list.
checks.proof_limits: This is an active collector/evaluator contract gap, not a reason to weaken the full-representation guard. No synthetic full attestation or provider-side compliance boolean is added.

prior_proof.reason: Prior callbacks are wrapper-hashed; new exact native matrix supplies current production proof. Prior specialized tests are context only unless separately verified.
